items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Buddy and I started playing the same day.

ctx.x: I first saw Eddie in 1925 with his brothers. They had The Durham Brothers' Band. They came from Terrell, Texas and I first saw them around the same time Alphonso Trent showed up around Dallas. And I said Jesse Stone, Pete Johnson, Walter Page and Hot Lips Page. Emil Williams was a very, very

famous piano player. I called his name to you. And Buddy Tate. Buddy and I started playing the same day. Budd Johnson, Bennie Moten and his brother, Buster. Willie Mack Washington. Willie Mack Washington I knew in Waco, Texas in 1914. Joe Turner. Alvin Burroughs' was a drummer that I think was with Earl Hines.
